original_ai_output.title_zh: PIAC要求提供拨给Big Push项目的石油资金明细
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳公共利益与问责委员会（PIAC）发布2026年半年度石油收入管理报告，指出政府若能提供拨入国家预算的石油收入使用明细，将有助于加强对其支出的评估。该报道目前为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: PIAC发布2026年半年度加纳石油收入管理报告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Public Interest and Accountability Committee (PIAC) released its 2026 semi-annual report on Ghana’s petroleum revenue management

key_facts.fact: PIAC称政府提供石油收入使用明细将加强对其支出的评估
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: additional information on how the government uses petroleum revenues allocated to the national budget would strengthen its assessment of government expenditure

key_facts.fact: PIAC要求提供拨给Big Push项目的石油资金明细
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: PIAC seeks details of petroleum funds allocated to Big Push projects

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（MyJoyOnline）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
政府是否已回应或提供相关明细尚未证实
